m4.suppression_summary: The naive 1/N_gal suppression picture is WRONG at the per-pair level and RIGHT at the population level. Per-pair: for truly-overlapping balls the shared set is a large fraction of the smaller ball (min-side COUNT share median 0.40, p90 = 1.0 i.e. full subset, both venues), and the natural negligibility denominator — min-side shared w_pop share — has median 0.087 / p90 0.296 / max 1.00 over the 80 sharing C-4 pairs at joint_r1 (geometric-mean variant: median 0.179 / p90 0.464); wN-weighted (h=0.73) min-side median 0.031 / p90 0.518 / max 1.0. So a cross-term negligibility band CANNOT lean on per-pair weight suppression alone: tens of pairs have O(0.1-1) shared-weight fractions. Population-level suppression is what saves independence: only 349 of 1,260,078 event pairs (2.77e-4) share any 1D-ball galaxy at joint_r1 (280 of 1,260,078 = 2.22e-4 at iiib), only 143 (joint_r1) / 115 (iiib) of 1588 events are touched by a sharing C-4 pair, and the mass-conditioned 2D channel cuts sharing pairs to 104 (joint_r1) / 21 (iiib) globally and 27 / 5 within the C-4 set. Per-galaxy multiplicity is capped at 4 events. Any 'nats per unit of actually-shared population weight' budget should therefore be normalized per-pair with the stored per-pair shares (m4_results.json pair_records and global_pairs_shares.outside_c4_records carry every pair's w and wN shares, both sides), not with a blanket 1/N_gal factor. Runtimes: main census 20.9 s, global inverted-index check 4.8 s, global shares + predicate diagnosis 20.3 s (dev box, single process).

instrument_build.design_notes: ARCHITECTURE: crossterm_instrument.py has two strictly separated layers. (A) PURE MATH CORE (top of file, numpy/scipy only, no master_thesis_code imports, exercised by the toy tests): GalaxyZKernel/make_galaxy_z_kernel (rho_g = N(z;z_g,sigma_z)*w_pop_eff/Z_g, host window [max(z_g-4s,1e-6), z_g+4s], Z_g by fixed_quad n=50 with the Z_g<=0->1.0 production guard, rho NOT truncated to the window — matches bayesian_statistics.py:4788-4881); per_galaxy_numerator (N_g,i, event-window fixed_quad n=50); pair_joint_integral (J_g,ij over window intersection, empty/inverted -> 0.0); SharedGalaxyTerm/compute_pair_sums (returns RAW sums sum_wJ, sum_wN_i, sum_wN_j, sum_w, n_shared); delta_nats(sums, K) with explicit NaN/-inf semantics — K is caller-chosen, no normalization convention baked in, per the code contract. quad_n parameter defaults to production 50; toy limit tests pass higher n (documented as math-limit not production-quadrature tests). (B) PRODUCTION LAYER (lazy imports, never run): load_filtered_events (SNR>=20 then rel-dL<0.10 -> 1588); stage_event (verbatim :3157-3294 incl. pinv, slogdet sign, cond>1e16 exclusion, sigma2_cond floor 1e-30, proj); c4_pair_census (recon_c4_census.py recipe, pinned: r=2*sqrt(lmax(J Sigma J^T)), chord sky overlap, 2-sigma d_L interval intersection, on the FULL 1590-row frame, pairs then intersected with the filtered+staged event set); load_ball_sets (M-4 zero-compute recipe from frozeng posteriors_with_bh_mass JSON: ball_1d = galaxy_likelihoods UNION additional, ball_2d = galaxy_likelihoods only, non-digit keys skipped per trap 11, optional --spot-check-balls h-independence abort); build_handler (main.py:154-163 args, venue observed_catalogue_path); make_l_gw (3D _mvn_pdf at galaxy sky + d_L(z,h)/d_L_i); make_mz_factor (2D Gaussian mass-marginal :5048-5094, mu_cond via proj, Eddington-shifted M_eff applied by caller per :5030); make_w_pop_eff (dVc/dz/(1+z) * clipped f_k with the all-50-GL-nodes ZoA drop-entirely fallback per :4830-4856); 2D channel composes l_gw*mz per event so the core stays channel-agnostic. Venue configs pin the session-verified catalogue paths (iiib=cluster_parent_reduced_galaxy_catalogue.csv, joint_r1=observed_catalogue_seed900001.csv), the md5-shared CRB CSV, and per-venue frozeng + event_likelihoods sources. OUTPUT: JSON {meta, rows} with per-(pair,h,channel) rows carrying the three raw sums, sum_w_shared, sum_wZ_shared, n_shared, ball sizes, w-share of each ball, C-4 overlap degrees, w_G_i/j + L_cat_i/j read from event_likelihoods.csv at the np.isclose-matched grid h (h_grid_matched recorded; trap: float h equality), and a convenience delta_nats with K=sum_w_shared (meta documents that the analysis layer owns K). HARD-RAIL ENFORCEMENT IN CODE: --output is required with NO default; _guard_output_path refuses .json-less, existing, and any path containing /results/run_, /diagnostics/, /posteriors; --confirm-run (the pre-registration gate) is required for BOTH instrument and validate modes — without it the CLI prints a plan and exits without reading anything. A --mode validate is built (not run) that cross-checks Step-2 N_g,i against frozeng galaxy_likelihoods per-galaxy N_nobh rows per the contract's free validation hook. Option B (p_det-free) chosen: no SimulationDetectionProbability, no child_process_init, no BayesianStatistics instantiation (broken simulations symlink trap avoided); numerators and J contain no p_det by the MFG rule. SIGMA_V_PEC_KM_S=0 honored (no PV term added). Grid h=0.81 is on the 41-value diagnostics grid so w_G stratification covers all four floor h values.
instrument_build.open_questions: 1) Known truncation floor: the 4-sigma host window puts a constant ln Z ~ -6.33e-5 nat floor under the single-galaxy Delta (one rho in J vs two in N_i*N_j; measured this session with the independent quad script). Negligible vs any plausible X/Y band but worth a line in the pre-registration since it is a systematic offset, not noise. 2) run_validate builds the frozeng filename as h_{round(h,3) with . -> _}.json, giving 'h_0_6.json' for h=0.60 — the actual frozeng filename convention for the grid endpoints (h_0_6 vs h_0_60) was not verified this session (only h_0_61/h_0_62/h_0_73 observed); validate at h=0.73 is safe, check the endpoint naming before validating at 0.60. 3) Pairs whose events were dropped by the 0.10 dL filter or Fisher exclusion are silently removed from the 279 (census runs on all 1590 rows, evaluation only on staged events); meta records n_pairs_census vs n_pairs_evaluated so the readout can report the attrition — expected small but not computed this session. 4) The 'shared-galaxy w_pop share' stratification is implemented as the rate-weight share (sum_w_shared / ball w-total) plus raw sum_wZ_shared (w_g*Z_g over shared); if the pre-registration wants Z-mass shares relative to full-ball Z totals, that is a cheap addition (Z_g for all ball members) not currently emitted. 5) Performance is untested by design (BUILD ONLY): per (galaxy,h) kernels and per-galaxy l_gw closures are cached per h but the handler build (~minutes, ~GBs on the 22.6M-row catalogue) and per-pair quadratures were never timed; --pairs-limit exists for an authorized smoke run. 6) delta_nats defines sum_wJ==0 against a positive factorized reference as -inf; if the analysis layer prefers a finite sentinel for class-summing |cross-term| in nats, that convention must be fixed at pre-registration.
